idea: an app to find study partners in college

verdict.quote: Matches students with peers or tutors based on GPA, subjects, study style, and availability

gaps.gap: The app forces users to repeatedly reopen it because it closes on its own.
gaps.quote: To refresh it , I have to open it again and again.

gaps.gap: Free users are limited to only one hour of study time without a subscription, despite earlier longer access.
gaps.quote: they could only study for one hour without subscription.

gaps.gap: After an initial period, the free version restricts focus‑room usage to a maximum of one hour, reducing its usefulness.
gaps.quote: After 5 days, it does not allows me to be in focus room more than 1 hour.

gaps.gap: Cannot see following/follower list on mobile app, making it hard to check which friends are online
gaps.quote: You can’t see your following/follower on the mobile app.

gaps.gap: All participants are muted when many people are on camera
gaps.quote: The only downside is because so many people are on camera at once everyone is muted.

angle.title: Persistent Session Engine
angle.idea: Implement a native background service that keeps the study rooms alive and automatically restores the last session when the app is reopened, eliminating forced closures.
